children: of Ross Tackett as Chief Revenue Officer, effective October 1, 2026.
Tackett, who currently serves as Zscaler’s Head of Worldwide Sales, will oversee global revenue operations, sales organization, partner ecosystems, and go-to-market execution.
Tackett brings over 30 years of enterprise technology leadership, including three years at Zscaler and previous sales leadership roles at ServiceNow and Dell.
He succeeds Mike Rich, who is stepping down for personal reasons and will serve as a strategic advisor through December 31, 2026.
Shares of ZS were down 3.56% to $206.99 in premarket trading on Friday.
